tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gshed dmar lha lnga'i sgrub dkyil bdag 'jug gi yi ge blo dman 'jug bde bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī rakta ya ma a ti maṇḍa la ye/ sku bzhi'i bdag nyid bla ma dang / /gshin rje'i dgra la gus btud nas/ /de yi sgrub dkyil bdag 'jug bcas/ /blo dman 'jug bde bshad kyis nyon/ /'di la bzhi ste/ sngon du bsnyen pa dang / sa chog dang / sta gon dang / dngos gzhi'o/ /de'i dang po ni/ 'dir ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi rdo rje slob dpon la/ slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pas gsol ba 'debs na/ de rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ gnas dben par sgrub thabs ltar lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom ste/ gtso bo'i sngags 'bum dang / 'khor rnams la khri phrag re bzlas nas/ lha'i rjes su gnang ba'i mtshan ma thob nas dkyil 'khor gyi las la 'jug par bya ste/ sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa la/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa la skyong nul byas la mchod gtor dang nang mchod rdo rje dril bu la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams tshang bar bshams nas/ slob dpon pa'i dbus su 'dug la sngon 'gro'i gtor ma dang mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa nas brtsams te lha'i rnal 'byor bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin byas la/ lha'i nga rgyal gyis/ oṃ bhū khaṃ/ zhes pas nam mkha'i rang bzhin dang / hūm̐ laṃ hūm̐ zhes pas rdo rje'i rang bzhin can/ oṃ me dī ni badzrī bha wa bandha hūm̐/ zhes pas/ byin gyis brlabs pa ni sa sbyong ba'o/ /de nas slob dpon gtso bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa la/ slob mas phyogs bzhi nas mchod pa byin rlabs lhan cig tu bya ba ni/ hrīḥṣṭīḥs bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i/ zhes pa nas/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ zhes pa'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin la/ nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ /ces dang / so so'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs/

dri med yid du༞ zhes sogs tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pa'am/ yang na sngags kho na bya ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī rakta ya ma a ri maṇḍal sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhes sogs sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang / yakṣe ma me da oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes nang mchod phul/ gti mug rdo rje la sogs pas bstod la/ gshin rje 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor 'jigs/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo ni/ /sdig pa thams cad zad mdzad pa/ /mgon pos dkyil 'khor bri bar mdzod/ /ces gsol ba gdab/ slob ma med na rang gis brjod cing bsam mo/ /de nas/ hūm̐ badzra ud tiṣṭha/ zhes pas bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkhar btegs la/ rang gi mig g.yon pa ma las nyi ma dang / g.yas pa ṭa las zla ba/ mig 'bras hūm̐ las bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar bar bsam la g.yas g.yon du bltas pas/ bgegs bskrad cing gsos par bsam/ rkang pa hūm̐ las rdo rjer bsgom la/ rdo rje gsor/ dril bu gsil zhing / rdo rje'i 'gros gyis sa gzhi la bskor la/ ngag tu hriḥṣṭīḥbarjod cing / dbang ldan du gnas pas bgegs la bka' bsgo ste/ lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kun nyon cig /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /srung ba'i 'khor lo sbyor ba po/ /rdo rje'i gzugs ni 'bar ba yis/ /lus gsum las skyes dag par bya/ /gal te kha cig bdag las 'das/ /'jigs par 'gyur gyi gzhan du min/ /zhes dang / shar du rdo rje'i gnas su/ 'khor lo dang / lhor rin chen/ nub tu padma/ byang du ral gri bcug pas bka' bsgo zhing thams cad du rol mo drag po'i sgra dang / hriḥṣṭīḥbazlas pas bgegs bskrad par bya'o/ /de nas phur bu gcig bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las stod phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed dang smad phur bu'i rnam par bsgom nas ting nge 'dzin gyi bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong bcu dbang ldan gyi phyogs su bkug la/

de rnams kyi spyi bor phur pa btsugs shing tho bas brdung par bsam la/ oṃ gha gha/ gha ta ya gha ta ya/ sarba duṣṭaṃ phaṭa/ kī la ya/ kī la ya/ sarba pa paṃ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ badzra kī la ya/ badzra dha rod ādzñā pa ya ti sarba bighnān/ kā ya wāka tsitta badzra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing brdungs pas/ bgegs kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar phug nas sa gzhi dang sbrag par bsam la/ dngos su phur bu dbang ldan du gdab pa ni/ sa yongs su bzung ba ste/ nub dang po'i bya ba'o/ /gsum pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni gang du dkyil 'khor bri ba'i sa steng / sa lha'i manḍal tshom bu dang / de'i thog du mañdzi long pa'i steng du dri bzang gis byugs pa'i maṇḍal lha lnga bum thod dang bcas pa'i tshom bu bkod/ rdul tshon gyi phyogs yin na rta babs snam bu bzhi pa'i lugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi thig dur khrod med pa spyi 'gre btab la/ khyad par ni/ gshed dmar dkyil 'khor nang thig ni/ /rtsa thig la reg zlum por skor/ /dbus nas sum cha lte ba bskor/ /de yi phyi rol pad 'dab sa/ /mu khyud dang ni lte ba la/ /cha phran re re nang nas bskor/ /zhes pa ltar skya thig rdzogs par btab ste/ lha gnas so sor tshom bu bkod pa'am/ 'og tu lha bskyed pa dang bstun nas bkod kyang rung bas gang bde bya/ gtso bo'i steng du sa lha'i manḍal bshams/ de dag gi mthar dbang ldan nas brtsams te mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog dang / chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod gru bzhir bshams pa'i spyi mchod dang / de'i nang du lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i rengs bu mar me zhal zas re sgos mchod rnams phyogs bzhir re re/ gtso bo yab yum gyi shar nub gnyis su re re ste tshan pa drug bshams/ de tsam ma 'byor na ji ltar rigs pa dang / sa lha'i maṇḍal dang nye bar de nyid kyi sgos mchod spos mar me zhal zas dang / gtor ma yang bshams/

de dag gi phyi rol du dbang ldan nas brtsams te/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor mganyis sam lnga la sogs pa gang dgos dang / logs shig tu sngon 'gro gtor ma dang slob ma dbang bskur byed na de'i chas sogs 'og tu dgos pa rnams tshang bar bsham/ dpon slob so so'i mdun du nang mchod rdo rje dril bu dang gos zungs/ slob dpon gyi mdun du mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa gnyis kyis/ rnam rgyal la pad nyi la gnas pa'i rdo rje'i dbyug pa lnga bum pa dang bcas pa dang / las thams cad pa la rdo rje'i dbyug pa bris pa'i mtshan ma gdags/ ras bzang pos mgrin par dkri/ hrīḥṣṭīḥbazlas pa'i yungs dkar gyis brdegs/ gu gul gyis bdug ste bgegs bsal/ nang du gser/ dngul/ byu ru/ mu men/ mu tig ste rin po che lnga/ kanḍa ka ri/ dbang lag sle tres/ rgya mtsho'i lbu ba/ shu dag dkar po ste sman lnga/ gur gum/ tsanda dkar dmar/ dzā ti/ ga bur ste dri lnga/ nas/ gro/ sran dkar/ til dkar/ so ba ste 'bru lnga/ 'o ma/ mar/ sbrang rtsi/ bu ram/ lan tshwa ste snying po lnga rnams blug chu gtsang mas dgang / ku shas kha brgyan/ steng du dung chos gzungs rdor bzhag pa rnams legs par bsham mo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ dpon slob rnams gral la 'khod de/ sngon 'gro gtor ma chu 'am chang gis sbyangs la/ gtor ma la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor zhing / hrīḥṣṭīḥbarjod de bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ lag pa g.yon pa bstan te/ oṃ/ g.yas pa bstan te/ āḥ gnyis ka dang lag pa gnyis phan tshun bsnol te mthe'u chung sbrel mthe bong lag mthil du bkug sor mo lhag ma gshibs te cung zad zur du brkyang ba 'dab chags spyi'am bya khyung gyi phyag rgya bstan te/ hoḥ lag gnyis bsnol te rgyab sbyar ba'i srin lag sbrel mthe'u chung dang gung mo gnyis bkug ste mthe bong gis mnan/ mdzub mo gnyis bsgrengs pa 'chi med rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya bstan te/

hūm̐ zhes brjod/ lag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i srin lag nang du bkug mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab nas cung zad ma reg par bkug pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bstan te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/zhes yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ 'di rnams kyi bsam bya sgrub thabs na yod/ de nas spro na/ gtor snod kyi mthar shar du dbang po sa srung la zhes sogs 'og nas 'byung ba'i cho ga rgyas pas 'bul/ bsdu na lag gnyis phan tshun bsnol te rgyab sbyar ba'i mthe'u chung sbrel/ mdzub mo bsgreng ba lcags kyu ltar bkug la/ hrī ṣṭī dang / oṃ lo ka pa la sa pā ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa gtor snod kyi mthar byon te skad cig gis gshin rje'i gshed kyi skur gyur/ zhes brjod/ pad skor sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ ind+rā ya hrīḥ ya mā yaṣṭi: wa rū ṇā ya wi/ ku be rā ya kri/ i shwa na ya ta/ agna ye a/ nai ri ti ye na/ wā ya be na/ tsand+rā ya hūm̐/ arkā ya hūm̐/ brahma ṇā ya phaṭa/ ba sun dhā ra ཱya phaṭa/ bi ma tsi tra ya swā/ sarba bhu ta bhyo hā/ ha ha ha hi hi hi/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ swāhā/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ oṃ badzra puṣpe ā hūm̐/ sogs kyi mchod/ phyogs skyong ba 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod de nang mchod gtor/ dril bsil dang / bdud bzhi po ni rnams par 'joms/ /dpa' bo gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa/ /gshin rje'i mthar byed phyag 'tshal zhing / /phyogs skyong bco lnga'i tshogs la 'dud/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du/

sa'i phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te sgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na/ zhes sam/ slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams sgrub khang gi phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams rnams su bzhugs nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang / de nas kyang byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang bskyab pa dang sba ba'i stong grogs mdzod cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas rang dang sgrub grogs kyi gnas gsum bsrung / badzra muḥ zhes dang / lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa sa la reg ste/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po bdug pa can gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba rnams sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig ces dang / hrīḥṣṭī: ces brjod cing rdo rje gsor dril bu grag tu dkrol la/ gtor ma phyi dor ro/ /de nas gnas khang dang mchod pa rnams sngar ltar bsang zhing sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bhrūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams hūm̐ las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig brten las 'das pa'i dge ba las grub pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing gtsang ba/ yul nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi chad par gyur/ zhes dang / so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs nas/ shapta'i mthar sna tshogs rol mo dang /

gaṇḍe ra ṇi lan gsum brjod pas byin dbab 'di ma gtogs 'og nas 'byung ba'i mchod pa byin rlabs gzhan rnams la gaṇḍe ra ṇi dang rol chen bya mi dgos/ de nas tshogs pa che zhing slob dpon du 'os pa yod pa dang zhu 'bul byed par spro na las kyi slob mas thun mong du phyag gsum byas la manḍal tshom bu bdun ma phul te/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rig pa dang 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun rnams la/ rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin zab mo la gnas par zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes sogs brjod de/ phyag gsum byas pa slob dpon gyi mdun du me tog gis bkang ba'i snod spos ring dang bcas pa dang / gzhan rnams la so sor me tog re 'bul/ phyag gsum byas la 'grengs te 'dun pa dang bcas pa'i pus mo sa la btsugs la me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te/ kun bzang rnams sprul mchod pa'i sprin spungs gis/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod pa dang / /yon bdag bgegs zhi tshogs gnyis rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /gnyis med ting 'dzin dag la gnas par mdzod/ /ces lan gsum brjod cing / re re'i mthar me tog re gtor phyag gsum byas la slob dpon ma gtogs gzhan rnams las me tog de bsdu/ phyag gsum byas la/ thams cad kyis thun mong du maṇḍal 'bul ba zhu/ zhes bskul te/ tshogs pa thams cad kyis/ bla ma la tshogs kyi rdo rje slob dpon zhu ba'i yon du/ maṇḍal phul nas maṇḍal tshom bu dang bcas pa slob dpon gyi drung du bzhag slob dpon gyis kyang me tog tshom bu de nyid kyi steng du slar yang me tog bsnan la/ maṇḍal phul te/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o/

/zhes sogs brjod/ las kyi slob mas maṇḍal rten gyi drung sogs gang rigs su bzhag ste/ phyag gsum byas la rang nyid gral la 'dug go /de dag gi sdom ni/ phyag gsum btsal la maṇḍal dbul/ /phyag gsum btsal la me tog dkram/ /phyag gsum btsal la zhu 'bul bya/ /phyag gsum btsal la me tog bsdu/ /phyag gsum btsal la maṇḍal bskul/ /phyag gsum btsal la gral la 'dug /ces pa ltar ro/ /skyabs yul rnams mngon sum lta bur dmigs te/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes ci nus kyi mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/

zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyem ma sku mdog dkar mo rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab kyi thugs khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po yab yum kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs te yab kyi sku gang / de nas dbyibs brgyud de yum gyi sku gang / yab yum gnyis kyi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bdag gi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar thams cad gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas thon nas shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar bsam la ngag tu/ oṃ badzra satwa sa mā ya/ ma nu pā lā ya/ badzra satwa twe no pa/ tiṣṭha dri ḍho me bha wa/ su tā ོṣyo me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ sarba siddhimme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shre yaḥ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha/ hoḥ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badzra mā me muñtsa badzrī bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ zhes pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/ phyag 'tshal bstod de phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phyag 'tshal 'dud de phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gus pas sku la bdag gsol 'debs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gis༞ zhes sogs bshags sdom spyi dang mthun/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu/ spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus shel sgong dag pa ltar gyur/ rang skad cig gis gshin rje gshed du gyur pa'i snying khar aṃ dmar po las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dmar po las dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa/

de'i nang du nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ dmar po de las 'od 'phros pas/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs bar bsam/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod nas/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shrī rakta ya ma a ri maṇḍa la sa pā ri wā ra/ zhes pas phyag byas nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī rakta sogs kyi rjes la/ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ de bzhin du thog mtha' rnams kun la sbyar la/ pādyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shāpta/ zhes pa so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa byas la/ badzra muḥ'adir lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sdig ces sogs rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa nas gsungs pas kha bskang mod kyi/ rgyud de nas thod pa'i sa bon a gsungs pa/ bī rū pas hūm̐ du bshad pa sogs du ma snang bas bī rū pas rgyud 'di la brten nas sgrub thabs 'di mdzad pa min te/ bī rū pas 'phrul 'khor gyi phreng bar rgyud 'bum phrag gsum pa las byung ba zhes gsungs pas rgyud rgyas pa la brten nas mdzad pa'o/ yis tshogs zhing gshegs su gsol nas tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms te bsod nams kyi tshogs so/ /de nas/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas gzung ba'i yul dang bral ba rang gi sems kyi ngo bor gyur/par bsam la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ de ltar gzung yul ma grub pas 'dzin pas mi 'grub pa'i phyir/ gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang bral ba rang rig pa lha'i skur gyur par bsam la/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmā yo ga shuddho3haṃ zhes brjod/ yang rang nyid lha'i sku gdan dang bcas pa dbyug pa la thim/

de hūm̐ la/ de mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la thim/ de yang nam mkha' la sprin dwangs pa bzhin du gyur par bsam la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs te sngon 'gro tshogs gnyis bsags pa'o/ /de nas/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa rdo rjes mtshan pa rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ de'i steng du suṃ las rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin gyi ri rab gru bzhi pa/ lcog brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng du paṃ las padma dang oṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lte bar hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su bhrūṃ las gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes par byas pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan srung 'khor 'di rnams rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi gzhung che chung gnyis na mi gsal zhing / chag los kyang ma mdzad pas med kyang chog la/ byed na dpyal lo dang 'phags pa rin po ches skabs 'dir bshad pas shin tu legs pas de'i lugs su byas pa'o// pas steng na pha gu dang / drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa dang / mda' yab dang pu shus brgyan cing / dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu'i tog gis spras pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing / phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu la mchod pa'i lha mos bskor ba/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/

lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba'i dbus su paṃ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang phyogs bzhir aṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ bsam ste rten bskyed pa'o/ /de nas/ gdan dbus ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de yongs su gyur pa las hūm̐ dmar po las dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa/ de'i nang du nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ dmar po/ de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ dbyug pa hūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa ni/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dmar po yum rdo rje ro langs mas 'khyud pa/ shar gyi 'dab ma la gti mug gshin rje'i gshed dkar po tsartsi ka nag mos 'khyud pa/ lhor ser sna gshin rje'i gshed ser po phag mo ser mo phag zhal can mas 'khyud pa/ nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed dmar po dbyangs can ma dkar mos 'khyud pa/ byang du phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed ljang khu gau rī ljang sngon mas 'khyud pa ste/ dpa' bo thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i dbyug pa dkar po 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / g.yon na bdud mtha' dag gi khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs khar 'dzin pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ khro gnyer dang gsus khyim dang brla dang brang zheng rnams che zhing sbom la rgyas pa/ sku dang yan lag dang / nying lag thung zhing rags pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba klu brgyad kyis brgyan cing stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can 'dzag pa'i mgo bo brgya phyed kyis do shal dang / skam po lngas dbu la brgyan pa/

gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa gshin rje'i tshogs skrag par byed pa/ ma he dmar po'i steng na g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de dag gi pang na gnas pa'i yum rnams kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra grol ba/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ g.yas pas rdo rje gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mgo bo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis 'khyud pa'o/ /'khor lo 'di rnams mngal 'byin du 'dod mod/ bi rū pa'i dgongs pa min te rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa dang rgyud de'i rjes 'brang blo gros bzang po'i sgrub thabs nas bshad kyang / de dag la rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa dang zhu ba glus bskul sogs bshad pas de dag kyang dgos par 'gyur la/ rgyud dang slob dpon des ye shes sems dpa' dgug gzhug byas nas dbang bskur/ ma gsungs pa dang / bi rū pas dbang bskur ba'i phyi la bshad pa 'gal lo// shar lhor mu men gyi bum pa bzhi mnyam gyis gang ba/ lho nub tu gser gyi bum pa gla rtsis gang ba/ nub byang du byi ru'i bum pa sihlas gang ba/ byang shar du dngul gyi bum pa ga bur gyis gang ba ste bzhi ka'ang thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas kha bcad pa'o/ /de nas/ gtso bo'i thugs khar padma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bo dbyug pa dkar po'i dbus su ting 'dzin sems dpa' 'am nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ dmar po/ bsam ste bsnyen pa'o/ /de nas hūm̐ las byung ba'i yab kyi rdo rje dang / a las byung ba'i yum gyi padma snyoms par zhugs pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i bde bas rgyud gang bar bsam la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ yum gyi lte ba'i 'og tu hrīḥlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hrīḥdamar pos brgyan pa/

rtse mo nas spyi bo'i bar spyi bo'i bdud rtsi las thon pa'i re kha dkar po padma'i snal ma ltar gnas par bsam/ de nas/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin pa āḥdamar po/ thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po/ gnas gsum byin rlabs gzhung che chung na med pas ma byas kyang rung zhes rin po che bu ston gsung / bsgom ste/ de dag las 'od 'phros pas sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje spyan drangs pa nas yi ge gsum la thim pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje rang bzhin du gyur par bsam la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāktsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃḥ zhes brjod pa ni sgrub pa'o/ /de nas/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rigs lnga yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ pādyaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhes sogs/ shapta'i bar gyis mchod de/ oṃ a bhi ṣīñtsa tu maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur lus gang / dri ma dag nas/ dbang bskur gyi lha rnams cod pan du gyur pa ni gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa' 'am 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbu brgyan te/ sgrub pa chen po'o/ /slar yang thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ ye shes sems dpa' lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī rakta ya ma a ri maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhāḥ/ pādyāṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhes sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dgug gzhug cing dbang du bya ba ni nye bar sgrub pa'o/ /de nas lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad de bskyed pa'i rim pa'o/ 'dir sems dpa' sum brtsegs 'dod mod/ bi rū pa'i gzhung las sngar gyi de las ma bshad do/

/yang sngar gyi/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad gzhal yas khang dang lhar byas nas tshur 'dus te rten dang brten par bcas pa la thim/ de rnams gtso bo yab yum la/ yum yab la/ de ye shes sems dpa' la/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la/ de u ha la thim/ de mgo bo la zhes pa nas/ sprin dwangs pa bzhin gyur par gong bzhin brjod la cung zad mnyam par bzhag rang skad cig gis rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ zhes dang dag pa dran pa ni/ dmar ba nyid ni 'dod chags la sogs pa brlag pa'i don to/ /spyan gsum ni 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i dus gsum gyi phyir ro/ /phyag gnyis ni dngos po dang dngos med la sogs pa'i rtog pa 'joms pa'o/ /shes rab ma dang 'khyud pa ni stong pa dang snying rje tha mi dad pa'i sbyor bas so/ /klu brgyad ni rnam par shes pa brgyad mtshon pa'o/ /mgo bo'i phreng ba brgya phyed ni yi ge lnga bcu'i sbyor bas so/ /g.yon na thod pa ni ye shes lnga bdud rtsi'i ros yongs su gang ba'i stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /g.yas na dbyug pa ni phung po dang / nyon mongs pa dang / lha'i bu dang 'chi bdag gi bdud bzhi rnam par 'joms pa snying rje'i rang bzhin no/ /g.yon brkyang ba'i gom stabs ni/ khams gsum rnam par mtshon pa'o/ /lha mo'i phyag g.yon par bdud bzhi'i khrag ni ro dang bcud len du ma kun nas myang ba'i phyir ro/ /g.yas par rdo rje gri gug ni dngos po dang dngos med kyi rnam rtog gcod pa'i phyir ro/ /gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir khro bo'i gzugs nyid do/ /gsus pa che ba ni mya ngan las mi 'da' ba'i phyir ro/ /dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa ni sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i yon tan gong nas gong du rgyas pa'i phyir ro/ /ngos bzhi dpal 'dzin gyi bcu gsum mar/ ngos bzhi 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi/

/sgo bzhi bdud bzhi skrag par byed/ /ces so// ni sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung dang / 'gog pa dang / lam gyi bden pa bzhi rab tu rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /sgo bzhi ni bdud bzhi kun las skrag pa'i phyir ro/ /zur bzhi tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi rab tu rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /ka ba brgyad ni rmi lam lta bu dang / dri za'i grong khyer lta bu dang / sprul pa lta bu dang / brag cha lta bu dang / sgyu ma lta bu dang / smig sgyu lta bu dang / me long gi gzugs brnyan dang / chu'i zla ba dang / nam mkha'i dngos po dang / dngos po med pa'i nyon mongs pa 'joms pa'i phyir ro/ /rta babs bzhi ni sbyin pa dang / snyan par smra ba dang / don spyod pa dang / don mthun pa nyid dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi rnam par dag pa'i don te/ zhes dran par bya'o/ /de nas sngar gyi sems dpa' sum brtsegs gsal btab la/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ zhi rgyas la sogs pa'i 'phrin las bsgrub nas/ slar yang ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la thim par bsam zhing / ngag tu/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ snying po dang / oṃ hauṃ kṣauṃ kṣa yaṃ ka ra ya gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ nye snying dang / oṃ ma hā yakṣa se na a dhi pa ta ye ma hā durdanta da ma kā ya/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ bi tra pa ya bi tra pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ phreng sngags dang / oṃ dāe ṣa ra tri nu tra nu tra/ tru ṭa tru ṭa hūm̐ dzaḥswāhā/ yum gyi snying po'o/ /oṃ mo hānta kṛtta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bi shu nānta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rā gānta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ irṣ+yanta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ dpa' bo bzhi'i sngags dang / oṃ mo ha ra tī hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ bi shu na ra tī hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ rā ga ra tī hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ irṣ+ya ra tī hūm̐ dzaḥ yum bzhi'i snying po ste/ de dag ci rigs par bzlas pa'i mthar/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pas bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

myur du bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ dkyil 'khor gong du bsdus grub pas skabs 'dir 'od gsal gyi dkyil 'khor mi dmigs par bsam pa las bsdu mi dgos/ nang mchod byin rlabs 'og tu mdzad kyang 'dir byas na bde bas nang mchod/ hrīḥṣṭiḥyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i thod pa'i nang du/ go ku da ha na las byung ba'i sha lnga/ bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga/ de dag gi steng du oṃ yig dang / a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ 'og gi rlung bskyod pas me 'bar nas rdzas rnams bskol zhing gcig tu gyur te/ oṃ dang zla ba rdo rje dang bcas pa'ang lhung bas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur par bsam la/ lag pa g.yon pa reg cing / oṃ zhes pas sbyangs/ g.yas pa dang / āḥyis rtogs/ gnyis ka dang / hoḥdang bya khyung gi phyag rgyas sbar/ 'chi med rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya dang / hūm̐ gi sgron ma ltar byas/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas thim par bsam la/ sa chog gi phyogs bzhir gsol btab bzhin mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs byas la/ sa lha'i tshom bu bkod ma zin na/ dri'i thig le dang me tog gi tshom bu gcig byas la/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī/ zhes brjod/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyis sa phyogs de rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ gur/ bla bre ye shes kyi me ri rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ rang gshin rje'i gshed du gsal ba'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas sa 'og nas baṃ las byung ba'i sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/

lus phyed thon pa/ phyag g.yas pa dam bca' khas len pa'i phyag rgya dang / g.yon pas bum pa 'dzin pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs nas/ maṇḍal gyi tshom bu'i steng du bdag la zhal phyogs pas bzhugs par gyur/ zhes brjod/ pṛ thi wī/ zhes sogs mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba/ arghaṃ༞ nas/ shapta'i bar dang / ghaṇḍe ra ṇis rol mos phul/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nang mchod gtor ma sbyangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ lag pa g.yas mchog spyin dang / oṃ pṛ thi wī/ zhes sogs kyi mthar/ a kā ro༞ btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ pus mo g.yas pa sa la btsugs te spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu bcad gtub tu gsil zhing / skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi dpung bcom pa/ /de ltar bdag gis bdud kyi dpung / /bcom nas dkyil 'khor bri bar bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum gyi mthar/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa༞ zhes sogs nas/ 'tshal na/ /zhes pa'i bar sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin brjod la/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod pas/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba thob par gyur/ zhes dang / slar yang gong ltar mchod la lag pa g.yas pa rdo rje dang bcas sa la reg ste/ badzra muḥsa'i lha mo sa de nyid la thim/ zhes brjod la mchod gtor dman pa rnams bsdu'o/ /lha sta gon ni/ mdun bskyed kyi maṇḍal bsangs sbyangs byas la/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las mdun bskyed kyi tshe'ang 'byung bzhi ri rab bsgom pa ngor chen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi maṇḍal mchod chog na gsal bar bzhugs so//

rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ zhes pa nas/ phyogs bzhir aṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar brjod la/ sngar tshom bu bkod ma zin na las kyi rdo rjes lha gnas so sor dri bzang byug cing / me tog tshom bu 'god pa dang bstun te slob dpon gyi dbus su/ hrīḥṣṭiḥdang / shar nas brtsams te/ oṃ mo hānta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sogs bzhi dang / de rnams kyi steng du slar yang me tog cung zad re bsnan la/ oṃ dwe ṣa ra tī sogs dang / oṃ mo ha ra tī hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes sogs dang / mtshams bzhir/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ste sngags rnams lan gsum re brjod/ tshom bu sngar nas bkod zin na sngags rnams ngag tu brjod pa tsam gyis chog sngags de rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus su bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dmar mo/ /zhes sogs kyis lha lnga bum thod dang bcas pa bskyed nas/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ dmar po/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ de nas/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ padyaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhes sogs/ shapta'i bar gyis mchod de/ oṃ a bhi sogs nas/ gtso bo nyid kyis dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ slar yang thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ gshin rje'i gshed lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ mtshan sngags tshar gcig sngon du 'gro bas/ arghaṃ nas/ shapta'i bar gyis mchod la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas bstim de nas/ sa chog dang 'brel bar byed na bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkhar btegs pa tshom bu'i steng du phab ste zhal phyag gsal 'debs pa las yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyis bskyed mi dgos/

rang gi snying kha nas zhes pa nas/ srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ zhes pa'i bar/ sa lha'i skabs su 'byung ba ltar gyi srung 'khor gsal btab slar yang mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs te bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad par mos la/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar/ dri med yid du 'ong ba/ 'don pa bsgyur ba'i mjug tu mtshan sngags re re nas sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod yon nas/ rol mo'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya/ gos zung bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gos srab pa/ 'jam pa/ yang ba/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ zhes dang / 'dzam bu'i gling dang gling gzhan rnams/ /lha rdzas na bza' bkang ba yang / /bla ma gshin rje gshed po la/ /zhum pa med par byas te 'bul/ /hrīḥṣṭiḥ'i mthar/ oṃ badzra wa sa sya āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis lha rnams kyi rgyab nas stod g.yog dang / mdun nas smad g.yog 'bul ba'i tshul bya/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod nas gtor te/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pa/ grub chen ḍombi he ru ka wī ra ḍi pa 'gro ba'i dpa' bo/ gambhi ra ma ti/ zab pa'i blo gros/ niska la ka de wa/ snyogs pa med pa'i lha/ ra wend+ra/ nyi ma'i dbang po/ chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal/ go lung pa mdo sde dpal/ shangs ston blo gros brtan pa/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug bya sder ba byang chub rin chen/ ra ga brag pa shākya seng ge

chos rje jo nang pa/ phyogs las rnam rgyal/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rje btsun dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug 'dren mchog dam pa dkon mchog 'phel/ lha mchog seng ge sangs rgyas seng ge nam mkha' dpal bzang / ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen chos kyi rgyal po/ bdag gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dpal gnas gsar ba chen po 'jam mgon bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag nos/ chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥṣṭīḥsogs kyi dkyil 'khor pa'i sngags kyi mthar/ gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ bla na med pa'i rgyud/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du༞ de nas rang gi lce rtse smin mtshams/ spyi gtsug rnams su thig le byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod de myangs pas lus kyi lha rnams tshim par bsam/ skabs 'dir gtor ma rnams la bar phud cung zad blug la chu dang chang sogs kyis bran no/ /de nas/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ shrī dharma pā la tsa turmu khā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bstan srung dam tshig can rnams kyi༞ phyogs skyong bcu/ lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ gza' dgu/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba chen po rnams kyi༞ gzhan yang gnod sbyin/

srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong / pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi༞ bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi༞ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skyes gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ tshim zhing zag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang nas myur du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig ces dang / rang gis kyang myangs la/ a mṛ ta swa da na/ sogs brjod/ de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje'i gshed po shin tu 'jigs/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /sku yi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /ser sna rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje'i gshed po shin tu 'jigs/ /sems kyi rdo rje rab tu gsal/ /rin chen rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /khyab bdag chags pa chos 'byung gnas/ /dbyangs mchog kun gyi mchog gi mchog /gsung gi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje'i gshed po las kun byed/ /sku yi rdo rje rab gsal ba/ /phyag na ral gri khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun rab mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstod la/ skabs 'di'i 'og bum bskyed kyi mjug tu gtor ma rnams sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ 'bul ba'i tshe 'das pa'i gtor ma mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la 'bul ba las/ gtor mgron gsar du spyan 'dren mi dgos/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī rakta ya ma a ri maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ pādyaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/

zhes mchod yon dang / zhabs bsil phul/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can las 'od byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ rakta mu ku ṭā ya raktā dza ḍā ya/ rakta mu khā ya/ rakta sha ri rā ya/ rakta bhu dzā ya/ rakta muṇḍa ma la bha ra ṇā ya/ rakta rā thā sa ma ru ḍhā ya/ rakta padma ā pa nā ya/ rakta bhi ra ṇa bhu ṣa ṇā ya i daṃ ba liṃ/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ ma ma bhighnān/ ha ra ha ra/ tsa tur mā ran ni bā rā ya ni pā rā ya/ bhra ma ya bhra ma ya/ tshindha tshindha/ bhinda bhinda/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ sho ṣā ya sho ṣā ya/ tshe da tshe da/ bhe da bhe da/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ gtor sngags lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul/ oṃ badzra puṣpe/ sogs kyis mchod/ gti mug rdo rje/ sogs kyis bstod pa rnams gong bzhin byas pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ nag po chen po sogs sgos kyi chos skyong la 'bul na/ so so'i cho gas skabs 'dir 'bul/ phyogs skyong rnams la gtor ma byin rlabs bsdus pa sngon 'gro gtor ma ltar byas te/ gtor snod kyi mthar g.yas skor gyi shar du dbang po sa srung la zhon pa/ lhor gshin rje ma he la༞ nub tu chu lha chu srin la zhon pa/ byang du lus ngan gter la gnas pa/ dbang ldan du dbang ldan khyu mchog la༞ mer me lha ra skyes la༞ bden bral du srin po ro langs la༞ rlung du rlung lha ri dwags la༞ dbus su tshangs pa/ mdun du zla ba/ rgyab tu nyi ma/ gzhogs g.yas su nor 'dzin ma/ g.yon du thags bzang ris/ de rnams la srid pa gsum na spyod pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs kyis kun nas bskor bar dmigs la/ de rnams skad cig gis 'od gsal gyi mes stong par gyur pa'i ngang las/ gshin rje'i gshed yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur pa la/ oṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/

oṃ pādyaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhes mchod yon dang zhabs bsil phul nas/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis 'od kyis gsol bar bsam nas/ oṃ ind+ra ya hrīḥzhes sogs nas bzung / kun 'grub par shog bar sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin phul/ snyan gsan dbab pa'i phyir/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed rdo rje/ /rig pa'i rgyal mchog khyod la 'dud/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dkyil 'khor 'bri bar bdag 'tshal lo/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /bka' drin gnang bar mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /'byung po byang chub bstan gnas dang / /sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang su rdo rje'i spyan ldan rnams/ /bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje 'chang chen rnal 'byor bdag ces 'don pa bsgyur/ che ge bdag /gshin rje'i gshed dmar dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji ltar nus pa'i nyer spyod kyis/ /'gro ba sbyong phyir bri bar bgyi/ /deng bdag slob mar bcas pa la/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung nas/ /'dus pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /nye bar gnas par mdzad par rigs/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthar/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gsungs par bsam mo/ /de nas phyag len la skabs 'dir bum bskyed mdzad pas/ bum pa gnyis/ hrīḥṣṭīḥs bsangs/ swa bhā wās sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi steng du baṃ las rin po che'i bum pa gnyis lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa dkris pa/

dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba/ rnam rgyal bum par sna tshogs pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang / phyogs bzhir nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re las thams cad pa'i bum par padma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du yaṃ las zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed dmar po yum rdo rje ro langs mas 'khyud pa/ de bzhin du/ shar du kṣe las gti mug sogs/ lhor ma las ser sna༞ sogs/ nub tu me las 'dod chags༞ sogs/ byang du da las phrag dog sogs kyi lha yab yum dang / shar lhor mu men kyi bum pa༞ zhes sogs sgrubs thabs bzhin bskyed/ las thams cad pa'i bum par da las phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed ljang khu gau rī ljang sngon mas 'khyud pa/ rgyan cha lugs thams cad gzhan rnams dang mtshungs so/ /de thams chad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ zhes sogs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ zhes pa'i bar lha sta gon bzhin las/ lhag por/ las bum gyi phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed la'ang gtso bo nyid kyis dbu brgyan/ zhes brjod/ de nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī rakta/ zhes sogs re re nas sngon du 'gro ba'i/ arghaṃ༞ nas/ shapta'i bar dang / ghaṇḍe ra ṇi'i rol chen bya/ yakṣa ma me da da oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nang mchod phul/ gti mug rdo rje༞ sogs kyis bstod nas/ pad kor sngon du 'gro bas gzungs thag blangs te/ bdag gi zhal nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril te song ba lha rnams kyi sku la phog pas/ ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsam la rnam rgyal la lha so so'i sngags dang las bum pa/ hrīḥṣṭīḥdang / hūm̐ bzlas slar yang gong bzhin mchod bstod/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya dang / ma 'byor pa dang zhes sogs kyi mthar/ pad kor gyi lag pas dung chos kyi chu bum pa gnyis su blug la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/

zhes brjod/ bum pa lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /'grub na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dang slob ma sta gon dgos na'ang bya/ gsum pa rjes chog ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī rakta/ zhes sogs mtshan sngags re re nas sbyar ba'i arghaṃnas/ ghaṇḍe ra ṇi'i bar gyis mchod/ yakṣe ma me da oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nang mchod gtor/ gti mug rdo rje'i༞ sogs kyis bstod/ lhag chad kha skong dang bzod gsol gyi mthar dkyil 'khor bteg pa'am yang na dkyus ltar bya/ rdo rje khu tshur gyis mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel mdzub mo gnyis brkyang ste rtse sprad pa rdo rje gtsug tor ram rdo rje shugs kyi phyag rgya spyi bor bzlog ste/ oṃ badzra be gā kra ma ho/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg par bsam la/ sta gon gyi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar byon te ji srid sang spyan ma drangs kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes brjod slar yang gong bzhin mchod bstod byas la/ yig brgya'i mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang / zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ gtor mgron rnams la bris sku sogs rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don du mdzad/ /ces sogs kyi mthar mtheb srin gyis se gol dang / badzra muḥ rten la ma brten pa'i ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ zhes sogs kyis rang gi gnas gsum bsrungs la/ sta gon gyi mchod gtor man ma rnams bsdu'o/ /thig tshon byin rlabs so sor bshad kyang skabs 'dir gnyis ka phyogs mthun du mdzad pas rang gi mdun du ras la sogs pa'i steng thig tshon sngon po dbus/ dkar po shar/ ser po lho/ dmar po nub/ ljang khu byang du bzhag tshon rnams la rdo rje'i rtses rim pa bzhin/ ya kṣe ma me da/ bris mchod pa bshams la/

rang gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis thig tshon bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad nyi lnga'i steng du thig tshon sngon po ya las zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dmar mo yum rdo rje ro langs mas 'khyud pa/ dkar po kṣe las gshin rje gshed dkar po tsartsi ka nag mos 'khyud pa/ ser po ma las ser sna gshin rje'i gshed ser po phag mo ser mo phag zhal can mas 'khyud pa/ dmar mo me las 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed dmar mo dbyangs can ma dkar mos 'khyud pa/ ljang khu da las phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed ljang khu gau rī ljang sngon mas 'khyud pa ste/ zhes sogs kyis gtso 'khor yab yum lngar bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ dbang bskur/ rang gi mig gnyis dza las byung ba'i zla ba dang nyi mar/ bsgoms la 'bar ba'i lta stangs dang / oṃ dipta driṣṭa aṃ ku sha dzaḥ zhes pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mdun du spyan drangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ pra yatstsha mo ha ya ma a ri swa tsakra pu pra na ma hūm̐/ zhes dang / de bzhin/ mo ha'i gnas su bi shun dang / ra ga dang༞ irṣ+ya dang༞ de ṣa༞ rnams bcug la gsol ba btab pas nam mkha' nas thig tshon la ye shes pa yang yang bstim la nyer spyod lngas mchod/ gti mug rdo rje༞ sogs kyis bstod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i thig tshon du bsam la/ oṃ badzra tsi tra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing lag g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis tshon rnams la reg cing yi ge rnams bsrubs la/ lha so so'i sngags kyis byinagyiis brlabs/ thig skud rnams slob dpon gyis lag par blangs te/ gti mug gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i slob ma la thig skud sngo dkar ser dmar ljang khu'i rim pas thig sna gtad de brkyang la/ oṃ ā n+yo3n+ya a nu ga tāṃ/ sarba dharma spha ra spha ra/ a nu pra wiṣṭeḥ sarba dharma a dyanta a nu pra wiṣṭaḥsarba dharma oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod la/ dang po so so dang / de nas lhan cig tu bsgril bas/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gnyis su med par gyur par bsam la/ rdo rje la dkris te dri bzang gis byugs la/ gser gyi snod du bzhag nas/ me tog la sogs pa lngas mchod do// hrīḥṣṭīḥbazlas pas bsrung / de nas slob dpon langs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi nub tu gnas pas/ dzdzaḥsogs kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas grogs la thig sna gtad/ des kyang / dzdzaḥ gsum brjod cing drangs la lte bar bzung la/ slob dpon gyis g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mtheb srin gyis/ oṃ āḥbadzra sa ma ya su traṃ ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing / thig gi sgra dang / sems can don la khyed rnams kyi/ /dus yin de ring 'dir spyon cig /ces pas bskul/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams thig la thim par bsgom la/ tshangs thig dang po gdab pa nas bzung ste thig rnams g.yas bskor gyis gdab dgos pa las/ gdab pa'i go rim ni/ nub shar lho byang me dbang ldan/ /rlung srin rlung dbang me srin po/ /g.yas bskor rgyab 'gros tshangs logs gdab/ /me rlung srin po dbang ldan nas/ /rgyab 'gros spangs te zur thig btab/ /gnyis sdebs dang po slob dpon dang / /phyi ma slob mar shes par bya/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de nas 'og tu bshad kyang / skabs 'dir slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badzra be ga kra ma hūm̐/ zhes pa'i rdo rje shugs kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas ye thig nam mkhar bteg la/ dkyil 'khor gyi nub nas dbus su zhugs te gar gyi 'gying dang bcas pas rdo rje dril bu dkur bsten te/ hrīḥlas mig g.yas g.yon gnyis nyi zla dang / mig 'bras rnams hūm̐ las khro bo'i rdo rjer bskyed la/ hīḥhīḥ brjod cing khro bo'i lta bas sgo bzhi la shar nas g.yas bskor du bltas pas sgo rnams bye bar khro bo'i rdo rje 'phros thar pa'i gegs su gyur pa'i gegs rnams bcom pas/) bsam/ sgo bzhi'i thad kyi rtsa thig rnams dri bzang gi chus phyis la/

thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i gegs su gyur pa thams cad dbye bar bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod/ ༈ /de nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su shar du phyogs pas 'dug 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /'jam dbyangs rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /'khor lo'i ngang du yang dag gnas/ /zhes brjod cing g.yon pa'i khur tshur gyis dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa rnams rim pa bzhin sgo tshad gcig tsam bris la/ bkab cing bsrung / me tog la sogs pa lngas mchod de/ dbus kyi phur khung 'og nas dkar po sogs kyis rim pas bkang la slob ma la sogs pas dbus nas rim pas bris/ rtsig pa sbrel ran pa na thod pa sogs bsal te sbrel/ mtshan ma brtag la ngan na nam mkha'i lha la mchod gtor phul te bsrung ngo / /tshon gyi kha dog ni/ dbus kyi sna tshogs padma ni/ /phyogs bzhi dmar la me rlung ser/ /bden bral ljang la dbang ldan sngo/ /lte ba ljang khu ge sar ser/ /phyogs mdog shar dkar lho phyogs ser/ /nub dmar byang ljang dbus sngo'o/ /sgo dang rta babs me ri'i bar/ /dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun par bris/ /padma'i lte ba dang phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhir/ nyi ma la gnas pa'i dbyug pa thams cad dkar po yin pa la/ gtso 'khor mi nor ba'i phyir du rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyis mtshan par bris/ lha bskyed pa'i tshe rdo rje dbyugs pa kho na yin pa lung sbyor las bshad do/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhir/ mer bum pa sngon po/ srin por ser/ rlung du dmar/ dbang ldan du dkar po rnams kyi steng du thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba re bris/ de ltar legs par bris zin pa dang / ye thig dang tshon lhag ma rnams bsdus te/ mchod bstod byas la/ ye shes pa rnams sta gon gyi lha'i thugs khar gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam/ ye shes kyi thig nam mkhar bteg pa bris pa'i dkyil 'khor la gnyis su med par thim/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod/ de tshon gyis bri ba'i cho ga'o/ /ras bris kyi phyogs yin na/ sta gon byas pa'i sa der bris sku rab gnas can zhal shar du phyogs par bkab te bkram/ dkyil 'khor gyi mthar ci tsam 'byor ba'i mchod pa bsham mo/ /de nas rdul tshon gyi phyogs la spos dang rol mo dang bcas pas slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal dang / las kyi rdo rjes las bum bzung la yig brgya brjod cing / dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum byas la/ lha so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ bdag gi slob ma la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes brjod cing lha de dang de'i mdun nas bum pa 'bul ba'i tshul byas te dkyil 'khor gyi shar du ji ltar rigs pa'i gdan la bzhag las bum la/ hrīḥṣṭīḥzlos shing / phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi las kyi bar chad thams cad srung du gsol/ zhes brjod de dbang ldan du 'god do/ /bzhi pa dngos gzhi la yang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las dang po ni/ sang nangs bar dkyil 'khor gyi mthar spyi mchod dang lha so so'i sgos mchod ji ltar 'byor pa dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma dang / sngon 'gro dang phyi rol pa'i gtor ma dang slob ma dbang bskur byed na de'i chas la sogs pa nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar tshang zhing bkod pa mdzes par bshams mo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang / 'jug cing dbang blang ba'o/ /dang po ni sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / gnas mchod byin brlabs nas brtsams te/ sgrub pa'i thabs nas 'byung ba ltar bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas par rdzogs par bsgoms nas/ nang mchod byin rlabs kyi bar thams cad sta gon bzhin byas la/ sngar bshad pa'i rdo rje shugs kyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ badzra be gā kra ma ho/ rdo rje shugs kyi rim pa'o/ /zhes pas rang dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su zhugs par mos la/

rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gshin rje'i gshed yab yum gyi rnam par 'khod par gyur/ zhes brjod bris pa'i dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes sogs pa nas/ aṃ dmar po las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod/ dbus kyi mtshan ma ya las dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa las rang dang tha mi dad pa'i bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dmar mo yum rdo rje ro langs mas 'khyud pa/ de bzhin du/ shar gyi mtshan ma kṣe dang dbyug pa las gti mug gshin rje'i gshed dkar po/ sogs rigs 'gres sbyar te lha lnga dang / mtshams kyi mtshan ma rnams yongs su gyur pa las shar lhor mu men gyi bum pa zhes sogs nas kha bcad pa'o/ / zin bris snga ma rnams las/ mtshams 'dir rang thal mo sbyar nas hrīḥṣṭīḥbarjod pas gtso bo la thim par bsam zhes 'byung ba'i rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pa'i don mi gnas shing gong 'og kyang 'khrugs pas dkyil chog gi dgongs pa min no/ /zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ de nas/ rang gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i hūm̐ las byung ba'i yab kyi rdo rje dang / a las byung ba'i yum gyi padma snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs nas zhal du zhugs pa byang chub kyi sems su gyur te yum gyi mkhar babs pas thig le cha gnyis su gyur/ cha gcig rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du lha so so'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ thig le cha gcig cha dgur gyur pa lha lnga bum thod dang bcas pa rnams su gyur pa ni/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed yab yum/

zhes sogs kyis lha lnga dang / mtshams bzhir bum pa la gnas pa'i thod pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba bzhi dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes ming brjod pas gsal btab/ de nas/ hrīḥṣṭīḥbarjod/ yum gyi mkha' nang gi gtso bo yab yum dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang dang rnam par shes pa'i phung po sbyangs/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus rang la thim pa ni/ rang nyid zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed dmar mo yum rdo rje ro langs mas 'khyud pa/ de bzhin du/ oṃ mo hānta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ gti mug gshin rje'i gshed spros/ gti mug dang gzugs kyi phung po sbyangs/ me long lta bu'i ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus shar gyi gti mug gshin rje'i gshed la thim pa ni/ gti mug gshin rje'i gshed dkar po sogs kyis gsal btab/ pi shū nān/ ser sna gshin rje'i gshed spros/ ser sna dang tshor ba'i phung po sbyangs/ mnyam nyid ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus lho'i ser sna gshin rje'i gshed la thim pa ni/ ser sna/ zhes sogs/ rā gān/ 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed spros/ 'dod chags dang 'du shes kyi phung po sbyangs/ sor rtogs ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus nub kyi 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed la thim pa ni/ 'dod chags/ sogs dang / irṣ+ya na/ phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi phrag dog dang 'du byed kyi phung po sbyangs/ bya grub ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus byang gi phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed la thim pa ni/ phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed ljang khu/ gau rī ljang sngon mas 'khyud pa/ dpa' bo thams cad kyang / zhes sogs nas/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkha' nang gi bum thod bzhi dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi yul drug gi sgrib pa sbyangs/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba la bkod/ tshur 'dus dkyil 'khor gyi mtshams kyi bum thod bzhi la thim pa ni/

shar lhor mu men gyi bum pa zhes sogs nas/ kha bcad pa'o/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ mkha' nang gi gzhal yas khang dpag tu med pa spros/ ma dag pa snod kyi 'jig rten sbyangs/ dag pa bde chen gyi ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus gzhal yas khang la thim pa ni/ 'byung bzhi lhun po dang bcas pa'i steng du srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du tshud pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ zhes brjod/ kha cig hrīḥṣṭīḥbarjod nas dkyil 'khor byung rdzongs su byung ba ni so so'i sngags kyis byung la zhes pa'i dgongs pa ma shes pa'o// de nas gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ dbang bskur ye shes pa rnams sta gon bzhin/ dngos gzhi sgrub mchod dang po'i tshe sta gon gyi lha la rdo rje gsor zhing / hrīḥṣṭīḥbarjod pas bgegs bskrad/ mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i/ arghaṃ nas/ shapta bar gyis mchod la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥyis bstims te/ brtan byed kyi bzlas pa bya mi dgos/ de nas mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin brlabs nas/ gos zung 'bul ba'i bar sta gon bzhin byas la/ de nas 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa ni/ 'dzam bu'i gling dang gling gzhan na/ /gzugs mchog tshogs kyis bkang ba yang / /bla ma gshin rje'i gshed po la/ /zhum pa med par byas te 'bul/ /hrīḥṣṭīḥdang / oṃ āḥru pa badzra hūm̐/ de bzhin du tshig dang po dang / phyi ma gnyis 'dra ba la/ tshig bar pa 'don pa bsgyur la/ sgra snyan tshogs kyis bkang ba yang / /sogs dang / hrīḥṣṭīḥ sogs dang / oṃ sogs kyi thog mtha' rnams 'dra ba la/ rū pa'i gnas su/ shapta dang de bzhin du/ dri mchog tshogs kyis༞ gandhe/ ro mchog dang / rā sa/ reg 'jam tshogs kyis bkang ba yang / /sogs dang / hrīḥṣṭīḥ.oṃ āḥ sparṣe badzra hūm̐/ zhes pas dbul/ de rnams kyi phyag rgya ni/ lag g.yon rdo rje khur tshur gyi steng du g.yas pa'i mkhrig ma bzhag

sor mo brkyang ba gzugs kyi'o/ /pi wang 'dren tshul sgra yi ste/ /lag g.yon dri yi dung chos dang / /g.yas pas byugs tshul dri yi 'o/ /rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i/ /snyim pa ro mchog 'bul ba'i steng / /na bza' 'bul tshul reg bya'i 'o/ /de nas rnam rgyal bum pa lag tu thogs la dkyil 'khor la 'bul ba'i tshul byas te/ nag po ra ri med pa yi/ /bum pa lto che bre tshad pa/ /mchu 'phyang mgrin ring gdan ldan pa/ /snying por ldan pa'i sman sogs gzhugs/ /mgrin par ras bzang dag gis dkris/ /'dab mar ldan pa'i lkug la yang / /dri dang ldan pa'i kha rgyan can/ /bdud rtsi ldan pa yis kyang mchod/ /de nas dril bu gsil zhing / gzhan yang mchod pa'i rnam pa ni/ /bla bre gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / /ba dan sil snyan rol mo yis/ /gus pas dkyil 'khor pa rnams mchod/ /ces pas mchod cing / de'i rjes su nang mchod rgyas pa dang / bstod pa sta gon bzhin byas la bzlas pa'i tshe lha rnams kyi sku la dmigs la/ dkyil 'khor kyi lha so so'i sngags ci mang bzlas/ mjug tu 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab la/ skabs 'di'i 'og bdag 'jug tshar nas sngar sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa lta bu'i cho gas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma rnams rgyas par 'bul la/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs kha nas gshin rje gshed kyi rnam par byon te rang gi gnas su 'khod/ ces brjod dkyil 'khor yol bas bcad de/ rang ngam gzhan gyis dkyil 'khor bsrung ba'i phyir/ hrīḥṣṭīḥkha yar bzla/ las kyi rdo rjes ji ltar rigs pa'i gnas su phyi rol pa'i gtor ma dang / de'i g.yas nas chu gnyis dang / g.yon nas nyer spyod lnga bshams/ gtor ma dang nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/ byin rlabs rgyas pa sgrub thabs ltar bya/ gtor snod kyi mthar/ zhes sogs nas/ kun 'grub shog ces pa'i bar dang / spro na/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhes sogs nas/

stong grogs mdzod cig ces pa'i bar sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin brjod/ las kyi rdo rjes zhal zas nas g.yas skor du mchod pa rnams gtor snod kyi nang du rim gyis bsdu/ mthar mchod yon gtor snod la bskor te/ 'gro phyogs su sgrengs la/ slob dpon gyis mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang / hrīḥbi shuddha sarba dharma sarba pā paṃ ni tsā sya saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpa na a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas yig brgya'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas gnas gsum bsrungs la/ lag pa g.yas pa brkyang ste/ badzra muḥ ye shes pa sgrub khang gi phyogs mtshams rnams su gshegs/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs/ zhes sngon 'gro gtor ma'i skabs bzhin brjod do/ /gtor ma ring du dor/ hrīḥṣṭīḥ bzlas shing rol mos mtshams bcad/ nang du 'ongs nas yol ba bsal ste/ rol mo dang bcas pas yig brgya brjod cing / dngos sam yid kyis dkyil 'khor la bskor ba byas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar du 'grengs te 'dud pa dang bcas pas/ bdag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / byings ba dang / rgod pa'i dbang du gyur pa dang / cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa dang / mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor ba dang / nyams pa la sogs pa dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub pa la skyon du gyur pa gang lags pa de dag thams cad bzod par mdzad de lhag chad kha skong bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes sam ma 'byor pa dang / zhes sogs gang rung brjod cing rdor dril dang bcas bzhin pas phyag gsum bya/ dngos gzhi sgrub mchod gnyis pa man chad la/ skabs 'dir bum bskyed sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'jug cing dbang blang ba la/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ 'dir las dang po pa'i dbang du byas te snga ma zhib tu bshad na/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma tha mi dad par bsam cho ga spod pa sogs slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang /

dbang rdzas 'grim pa sogs de'i thugs ka nas bye ba'i gshin rje'i gshed kyis mdzad par bsams la/ thog mar las bum gyi chus kha bkru zhing / ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gi khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing kha bshal la/ de nas/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul la/ mā ma kī dang lhan cig sbyor/ /bdag gi ston pa dga' chen khyod/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag ni bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /gsol ba btab/ rang skad cig gis gti mug gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yab yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ zhes brjod/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes pas me tog gi phreng ba blangs/ sngags de nyid kyis mig ras bcings/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed dpag tu med pa spros te dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par bsam la/ hrīḥṣṭīḥ brjod cing / las bum gyi chu gtor/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs kyis rgyun bshags dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa bzung ba'i yon du maṇḍal dang / 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang / /dam pa bdag la stsal nas ni/ /mgon po 'khor lo'i lha dag gi /de nyid slob dpon phrin las dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom pa gsang mchog rtag tu ni/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /slob dpon bdag 'gyur gsung du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ sdom pa bzung ba'i phyir/

sangs rgyas yang na sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bgyi bas/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /zhes brjod kyang chog dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag che ge mo zhes bya ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims bslab pa rnam pa gsum/ /dge ba dang ni chos sdud dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis so sor brtan por bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum mchog bla na med/ /sdom pa sangs rgyas rnal 'byor 'byung / /deng nas brtsams te bzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje chen po'i rigs bsdus pa/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /de nyid kyis ni rab tu gzung / /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen chen po'i rigs mchog ni/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du lan drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rab tu sbyin/ /padma chen po'i rigs dag sam/ /byang chub chen po 'byung ba la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam chos so sor gzung bar bgyi/ /las chen rigs ni bsdus pa la/ /sdom pa thams cad yang dag ldan/ /mchod pa'i las ni ci nus bzhin/ /kun nas so sor gzung bar bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa yang dag bskyed bgyi zhing / /sdom pa ma lus bzung bgyis nas/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung bgyi/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum brjod/ kye dga' ba la dga' khyed su yin/ /zhes dris des/ bde chen bdag ni skal bzang lags/

/zhes lan gdab/ rang gi snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi mtshon byed dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta u pā da ya mi/ zhes dang snying khar me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ su ra ti sa ma ya satwaṃ hāoḥsiddha badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod de brtan par bya'o/ /ā khaṃ wī ra zhes pas gtso bo'i drung du bzhag par bsam la/ dkyil 'khor la mgo dud tsam bya/ phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bas na ngas khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ zhes brjod/ nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bo dang / 'di ni rdo rje'i dam tshig ste/ /khyod kyis dam tshig rdo rje 'di/ /gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig la/ /'di smras na ni spyi bo 'gems/ /zhes brjod/ phan yon nyes dmigs gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ snying khar rdo rje bzhag la/ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang / /khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu bral te gshegs/ /zhes brjod/ mna'i chu blud pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ dung chos su dri bzang po'i chu la/ oṃ badzra u da ka ṭhaḥ bdun bzlas pa khar 'thung la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ste/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thungs shig

/oṃ badzra u da ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ zhes brjod/ bla ma'i bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces gang bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang mi bya ste/ khyod ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes pas dam la bzhag go /maṇḍal gling bzhi ri rab/ ces sogs nas/ ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes sogs brjod/ de nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod la/ rang nyid 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed du bsgoms pa'i spyi bor baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa'i dbus su haḥ snying khar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i dbus su hūm̐/ lte bar raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po rno zhing 'bar ba'i dbus su āḥ rkang 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa de la dzhaiṃḥdrag cing bzod par dka' ba 'bar ba'i gzugs brnyan rlung gis bskyod pas/ rkang mthil nas zhugs te/ lte ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor dang mnyam par phyin nas/ de'ang des bskyod nas shin tu drag tu 'bar bas snying kha'i sa'i dkyil 'khor bsregs/ dpral ba'i chu 'khol/ de las bdud rtsi'i tshogs babs/ rgyud tshim par gyur nas/ rkang 'og gi rlung gis 'degs bzhin par gyur/ de'i tshe gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas rang gi ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas sib sib thim par bsam/ gtso bos mdzad par bsam zhing rdo rje dril bu dkrol te/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭaḥ

a we sha ya satwaṃ bhā ya/ satwaṃ bhā ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsā la ya tsa la ya hūm̐ āḥhāḥdzhaiṃḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mang du brjod cing dbab bo/ /bdag 'jug gi tshe rdzas kyi dud pa mi mdzad/ brten pa'i phyir spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste/ tiṣṭha badzra/ zhes brjod la/ de nas sngar gyi me tog phreng ba de traṃ las rin po che'i me tog tu mos la/ gtso bo'i dbu la me tog phul bar bsams la/ oṃ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ zhes brjod cing dbul/ oṃ pra ti gṛhna satwa i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes pas me tog mgo la bcing / mig tu oṃ bsam/ oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang / /khyod kyi mig ni 'byed par brtson/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla med pa/ /thams cad mig ni 'byed par mdzad/ /zhes pas gdong g.yogs bkrol la/ he badzra pā shya/ zhes pa'i mthar/ spro na dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi ming tsam brjod/ bsdu na/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar gyur/ zhes brjod/ bdag 'jug gi tshe 'di tsam gyis chog de nas rdo rje slob ma'i dbang gi yon du maṇḍal phul nas/ sangs rgyas shes rab chen po yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag la'ang mgon pos dbang bskur zhing / /mchog kyang bdag la stsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab la las bum gyi chu bdag dang dbang rdzas la gtor te/ hrīḥṣṭīḥyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ bdag gi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / oṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ya las dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa las zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed dmar po yum rdo rje ro langs mas 'khyud pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i dbyug pa dkar po 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing /

g.yon bdud mtha' dag gi khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs khar 'dzin pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ khro gnyer dang gsus khyim dang brla dang brang zhengs rnams che zhing sbom la rgyas pa/ sku dang yan lag dang nying lag thung zhing rags pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan cing stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ 'dzag pa'i mgo bo brgya phyed kyi do shal dang / skam po lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pas gshin rje'i tshogs skrag par byed pa/ ma he dmar po'i steng na g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje ro langs ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ skra grol ba/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ g.yas rdo rje gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mgo bo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis 'khyud pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po/ rnam rgyal bum chu dbang rdzas la cung zad gtor la/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ zhes gsung zhing dbang rdzas kyis lha la dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las cod pan du gyur pa ni/ dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bor rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang rdzas lhar bskyed pa la thim/ dbang rdzas kyi zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ slar yang thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ

oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shapta āḥhūm̐ zhes dang / dril bu gsil thal mo dang / rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la/ /'gro ba skyobs pa'i ched du dbang / /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal/ /de ltar bdag la gnang bar zhu/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rdo rje tsartsi ka la sogs pa'i yum rnams kyis bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur bar bsam la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis/ /gsang gsum gnas byung sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badzra a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ zhes brjod cing dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag ste/ dbang gi lha rnams rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par byas nas rang gi spyi bor dbu brgyan te/ dbang bskur bar bsam 'og ma rnams la'ang dbang lha spyan 'dren dang / mchod pa sogs re re nas byed mi nus na/ dri ma dag te dbang gi lha rnams las dbang lha gnyis pa rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par byung nas bdag gi spyi bor dbu brgyan/ zhes brjod/ slar yang thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de gshegs pa thams cad zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs dang / shapta'i tshe dril bu gsil te/ de ltar na zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgo nas chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam shes phung po gnas gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas/ zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag ces rtogs pa bskyed do/ /bdag dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan bsangs sbyangs/ bdag gi tshor ba'i phung po dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / oṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ma las dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa las ser sna gshin rje'i gshed ser po yum phag mo ser mo phag zhal can las 'khyud pa/

zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i dbyug pa dkar po/ zhes sogs nas/ dbus na bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar dang / de'i pang na yum phag mo ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhes sogs nas/ 'khyud pa'i bar gong bzhin/ de'i dpral bar oṃ sogs nas/ thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po'i bar dang / gong ltar dbang rdzas la bum chu gtor la/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ zhes gsung zhing nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag ste dbang gi lha rnams las dbang lha gnyis pa zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par mched de dbang rdzas kyis lha'i spyi bor dbu brgyan/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ser sna gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang rdzas lhar bskyed pa la thim/ dbang rdzas kyi ser sna gshin rje'i gshed yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas cod pan du gyur/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la/ /zhes gong bzhin gyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ oṃ badzra ratna mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ badzra ra ga ta badzra sha li hoḥ zhes pas dbu brgyan bcing / dbang bskur rdo rje sogs kyi dbang bskur bas/ lus thams cad gang / dri ma dag ste dbang gi lha rnams las dbang lha gnyis pa zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par mched de byung nas bdag gi spyi bor dbu brgyan/ slar yang thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ser sna gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la thim pa sogs 'dra/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs nas/ shapta'i bar 'dra/ de ltar na ser sna gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgo nas dbu rgyan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag

tshor phung gnas 'gyur/ mnyam nyid ye shes mngon du byas/ ser sna gshin rje'i gshed kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag zhes rtog pa bskyed do/ /bdag dang dbang rdzas rdo rje bsangs sbyangs/ bdag gi 'du shes kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / aṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ me las dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje rtse mo can mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa las 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed dmar po yum dbyangs can ma dkar mos 'khyud pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i dbyug pa dkar po zhes sogs nas/ zhugs pa bar dang / de'i pang na yum dbyangs can ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa zhes sogs nas/ 'khyud pa bar gong bzhin/ de'i dpral bar oṃ sogs nas/ thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po'i bar dang / dbang rdzas la bum chu gtor la/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ zhes gsung zhing nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang rdzas kyis lha rnams la dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag ste dbang gi lha rnams las dbang lha gnyis pa zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par mched de dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bor dbu brgyan/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang rdzas lhar bskyed pa la thim/ dbang rdzas kyi 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la/ /sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje yi/ /dbang gis de ring khyod dbang bskur/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje rab tu grub phyir gzung / /zhes brjod de/ rdo rje snying mgrin dpral ba gsum du reg

dbang bskur rdo rje sogs kyis chu dbang bskur nas/ lus thams cad gang dri ma dag ste dbang gi lha rnams las dbang lha gnyis pa zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par mched de byung nas bdag gi spyi bor dbu brgyan/ slar yang thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par oṃ nas/ dzaḥdzaḥnas/ hoḥs/ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs nas/ shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ de ltar na 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes gnas gyur/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag ces rtogs pa bskyed do/ /bdag dang dbang rdzas dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ bdag gi 'du byed kyi phung po dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang aṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ da las dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa las phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed ljang khu yum gau rī ljang sngon mas 'khyud pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i dbyug pa dkar po zhes sogs nas/ bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum gau rī ljang sngon ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa nas/ 'khyud pa'o/ /de'i dpral bar oṃ sogs nas/ thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po'i bar dang / dbang rdzas la bum chu gtor la/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ zhes gsung zhing nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang rdzas kyi lha rnams la dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag ste dbang gi lha rnams las dbang lha gnyis pa zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par mched de dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bor dbu brgyan/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang rdzas lhar bskyed pa la thim/ dbang rdzas kyi phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la/ /sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ badzra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣañtsa mi/ tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas dril bu lag pa g.yon par bzung la/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs kyis chu dbang bskur bas/ lus thams cad gang / dri ma dag ste dbang gi lha rnams las dbang lha gnyis pa zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par mched de byung nas bdag gi spyi bor dbu brgyan zhes brjod/ slar yang thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par oṃ nas/ dzaḥdzaḥnas/ hoḥrang la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs nas/ shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ de ltar na phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya grub ye shes mngon du byas/ phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag ces sogs kyis rtogs pa bskyed pa'o/ /bdag nyid bsangs sbyangs/ bdag gi gzugs kyi phung po mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / aṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du kṣe las dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje rtse mo can mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa las gti mug gshin rje'i gshed dkar po yum tsartsi ka nag mos 'khyud pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i dbyug pa dkar po zhes sogs nas/ bzhugs pa/ de'i pang nas yum tsartsi ka nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa nas/ 'khyud pa'o'ibar/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin pa āḥdamar po/ thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po zhes brjod/ de nas/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab/
