lag pas rdor dril bsnol te bzung ba spyi bor bzhag oṃ badzra satwa satwaṃ a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ badzra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kyai dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing / che ge mo'i sar rdo rje'i ming gzhug cing dbang bskur/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs kyis chu dbang bskur bas/ lus thams cad gang / dri ma dag ste dbang gi lha rnams las dbang lha gnyis pa zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par mched de byung nas bdag gi spyi bor dbu brgyan/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gti mug gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par oṃ nas/ dzaḥdzaḥnas/ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs nas/ shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ de ltar na gti mug gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag gzugs phung gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ gti mug gshin rje'i gshed kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag ces rtogs pa bskyed/ dbang bskur ba 'di dag gis bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud 'chad pa dang sngags sgrub pa la dbang bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang lnga po 'di nyid cod pan gyi dbang ste/ thams cad du tsartsi ka la sogs pa rnams cod pan gyi dbang gi tshul du bya ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi yon du/ maṇḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung cig ces sogs kyis maṇḍal phul la gsol ba btab pa ni/ gang gi bdag nyid khyod drin las/ /rang dang gzhan don nus gyur pa/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang / /snying rje'i gter gyis bdag la stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab la/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i shin stan gyi steng du rang nyid bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dmar po yum rdo rje ro langs ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/

zhes sam spro na zhal phyag gsal btab/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas dbang bskur gyi lha bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkhar sprul te/ bdag la dbang bskur bar bsam/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis/ /gsang gsum gnas byung sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badzra a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ zhes pas bum chu 'thung la dbang bskur bar bsam/ de bzhin du/ oṃ badzra ratna mu ku ṭa.a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ badzra rā ga ta/ badzra sha li hoḥ zhes pas dbu brgyan cing / sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje yis/ /dbang gis de ring khyod dbang bskur/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje rab tu grub phyir zung / /zhes pas rdo rje lag tu bzung / oṃ badzra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ tiṣṭha badzra sa mā ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas dril bu lag pa g.yon pas bkrol/ oṃ badzra satwa satwaṃ a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ badzra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ zhes pas lag pa g.yas kyis rdo dril bsnol la spyi bor bzung la ming dbang rnams bskyar te bskur ro/ /de nas hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje lag pa g.yas par thogs la/ khams gsum pa yi ral gri che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /las kyi ral gri mchog lta bu/ /bdud las rgyal bar bya phyir zung / /zhes rdo rje byin pa gsor te snying khar bzung / thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o/ /rang gi sems thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi rdo rje/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi dam tshig yin no/ /zhes ngo sprad de/ rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig go /āḥlas byung ba'i dril bu lag pa g.yon du byin la/ shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin nyid/ /rdo rje dril bur rab grub phyir/

/bu yi yang dag gus par zung / /khyod kyis slob ma bsdu bar gyis/ /zhes pas dril bu byin pa dkrol te dril bu dku g.yon par brten la/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag mchog sems dpa' yis/ /dam pa'i srid pa byed par 'gyur/ /rang gi ngag skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba/ grags stong gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi dam tshig yin no/ /zhes ngo sprad pa ni/ dril bu gsung gi dam tshig go /rang zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed dmar po yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur pa'i lus kyi gnas nu ma la sogs pa reg pa'i bde ba nyams su myong bas/ yab yum gyi sku thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyis bum pa ltar gang bar bsams la/ shes rab ma 'khyud pa'i tshul byas la/ yid kyi lus rten de nyid la/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu bshad/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad rten/ /des na phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrags/ /zhes pa ni phyag rgya'i dam tshig ste/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon gyi ni dbang du mdzod/ /tha mal pa'i bde ba ni ma dag pa'o/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha yab yum gyi sku snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i rnal 'byor du byas te 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad la longs spyod cig gzhan thams cad kyang de bzhin du shes par gyis la mchod pa gyis shig de ltar byas pas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba 'di ni mi 'da' ba'i phyir dam tshig yin no/ /zhes bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos ngo sprad par bsams la don yid la bsam/ slar yang / dbang bskur rdo rje chen po sogs kyi rjes la/ lha thams cad kyi sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ zhes gsungs shing nam mkha' gang ba'i lha rnams kyis bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag

dbang gi lha rnams cod pan du gyur pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ slar yang bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs te/ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod/ me tog dor te/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ya swāhā/ zhes brjod cing rab gnas byas par bsam/ puṣpe sogs kyis mchod pa rnams gong bzhin mdzad/ dmar ba nyid ni/ zhes sogs kyis lha dang / dkyil 'khor gyi rnam dag sgrub thabs ltar brjod la don bsam/ de nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed dmar po yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur zhes dang / sems can kun la phan don phyir/ /'jig rten kun du thams cad na/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes brjod cing / bdag 'jug gi tshe rigs lnga'i phyag chen bca'/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi tshe 'khor lo sogs rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan 'grim zhing chos kyi gnas su/ rdo rje/ rin chen/ padma/ sna tshogs/ rnams 'don pa bsgyur la rjes gnang ngo / /brtul zhugs kyi tshe rang dang dbang rdzas rdo rje/ hrīḥṣṭīḥdang las bum gyi chus bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang dang 'dra ba'i yum rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ zhes brjod/ yan lag lhag ma rnams byed mi dgos/ dbang rdzas kyi rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ zhes dang rdo rje blang ba gsor zhing / 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha e ṣa satwaṃ dha ra ya mi/

badzra satwa hi hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes brjod la rdo rje spyi bo'am snying khar bzung la/ sgo gsum tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa thams cad gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rjes brtul nas/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku gsung thugs la zhugs par gyis shig ces ngo sprad phyag len la dbang rdzas dang slob ma gnyis ka rdor sems su bskyed par mdzad kyang / slob ma gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal can la/ rdor sems zhu ba'i rdo rje ster ba yin/ de nas bla ma shākya thub pa'i rnam par 'phos nas g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis snying khar chos gos kyi grwa ri dwags kyi rna ba lta bu dang / g.yas pa'i mchog sbyin pa'i phyag rgya rang gi gsang mtshan nas lung ston par bsams la/ dngos su rang gi lus kyi phyag rgya de ltar byas te/ oṃ 'dir ni ngas khyod lung bstan bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa mchog tu grub bya'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las bton nas/ /kyai che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba/ ta thā ga ta siddhi sa ma ya satwaṃ bhur bhu wa swā/ gang 'di dag las byung ba'i phyag rgyas lung ston par byed pa de la de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par mdzad do/ /de nyid las byung ba'i phyag rgya'i mthu dang sngags 'di'i stobs kyis so/ /zhes brjod de lung bstan pa'o/ /de nas/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig /khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral nyid/ /khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/ /ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas nyan rang gi yid byed kyi sems bcom par bsam ste/ gsang ba brjod pa'o/ /de nas/ mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor mthong zhing zhugs pa yis/ /sdig pa kun nas nges par grol/ /de ring khyed rnams legs par gson/ /bde chen theg pa 'di yis ni/

/phyin chad 'chi ba khyed la med/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las khyod 'das/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya gang yin pa/ /gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyi ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med/ /byang chub sems ni gtang mi bya/ /dam pa'i chos ni sun mi dbyung / /nam yang 'dor bar mi bya'o/ /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis/ /de yang nges par brten mi bya/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya rnams/ /nam yang 'dor bar mi bya'o/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /rang gi bdag nyid dor nas ni/ /dka' thub kyis ni mi gdung zhing / /ci bde bar ni bde bar zung / /'di ni ma byon rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /da ni khyod nyid dkyil 'khor gyi/ /slob dpon sngags dang brgyud 'dzin par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kyang ni mthun par dgongs/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ /khyod kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ /zhes pa'i don bshad de/ dbugs dbyung sbyin pa'o/ /rjes gnang la sogs pa lnga po 'di dag ni slob ma'i dbang tsam don du gnyer ba la cod pan gyi dbang lnga'i rjes sam/ skabs 'di'i dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i rjes la sbyar ba yang bshad do/ /de nas rtogs bskyed ni/ phyi rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi/ dkyil 'khor gang yin skabs dang sbyar la/ dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / mnyam med snying rje'i rnal 'byor/ rtsa ba rgyu'i rnal 'byor rnams sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed de/ slob dpon nam bum pa'i dbang ngo / /gsang dbang gi sngon du slob mas rig ma dang maṇḍal phul bar bsams la/ maṇḍal gling bzhi ri rab sogs nas/ gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/

/thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du sogs kyis dbul la/ byang chub rdo rje sogs sam/ e ma sangs rgyas slob dpon che/ /e ma chos dang tshogs kyi gtso/ /bdag la dam tshig de nyid stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis mig ras bcings/ bla ma gshin rje'i gshed dang rig ma ro langs la snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor ba byas pas/ dga' ba'i sgras sangs rgyas yab yum dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ rjes su chags pas byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur pa/ rdo rje nor bu rtse mor brtan par byas pa de nyid srin lag dang mthe bong gis btsir te/ rang gi lce thog tu bzhag par bsam la dngos su nang mchod bdud rtsi lcer bzhag la/ btung ba rin chen 'di de ni/ /lus kyi rdo rje rab gsal byed/ /bu khyod rtag tu shes na skye/ /yid las byung ba'i chu 'thung mdzod/ /hrīḥṣṭīḥyis sbyin par bsam la des kyang / a ho ma hā su kha/ zhes brjod cing blangs nas myangs pas mgrin par mid/ yum gyis kyang rang gi padma na gnas pa'i thig le sbyin par bsams la/ slar yang / btung ba rin chen sogs brjod cing myang ba sogs gong bzhin byas pas/ mchog tu dga' ba'i bde bas rgyud gang zhing yul sna tshogs la dmigs pa'i rtogs pa rags pa rnams 'gags nas/ gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la rgyas par bsgoms la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras bsal/ de ltar na khyod kyis byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lam srog rtsol rlung gi rnal 'byor dang / rten 'brel rdzas kyi rnal 'byor sgom pa la/ 'bras bu longs sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed de gsang ba'i dbang ngo / /de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du/ maṇḍal gling bzhi ri rab/ sogs nas/

shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du sogs kyis phul nas/ ji ltar bla med dpa' bo yis/ /mgon la dbang ni bskur ba ltar/ /mgon pos bdag la'ang dbang bskur zhing / /bdag la don mchog stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis mig ras bcing / bla mas rig ma'i lag pa bdag gi lag par gtad par bsams la/ gzung ma yid 'ong 'di de ni/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags/ /rdo rje rjes chags sbyor ba yi/ /bde ba dam pa myong bar gyis/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min/ /'gro gsum 'di yang dag pa yin/ /de bas 'khor bar sbyor bral ni/ /khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /ces brjod la byin par bsam/ des tsandan la sogs pas byug me tog gi phreng bas brgyan/ gos med par byas te padma rgyas par ston cing / dri chen dri chu za ba dang / /khrag dang khu ba de bzhin sha /bud med gus mchog de bzhin du/ /bha ga padma tsamba nam/ /bu khyod spro ba yin nam ci/ /ji ltar bde bar bus smros shig /ces dri ba byas par bsams la/ des kyang / dri chen dri chu sogs za ba/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus bya/ /bha ga nyid la tsamba ni/ /zhes lan btab pas mnyes te/ e ma nga yi padma 'di/ /bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ /gang zhig cho gas bsten byed pa/ /de yi mdun na bdag gnas so/ /sangs rgyas bsten pa la sogs pa/ /padmar bya ba ji bzhin byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ /bhañdza mokṣa hoḥ zhes brjod par bsams/ rang nyid gshin rje'i gshed dmar po dang rig ma ro langs mar bsgoms pa lha'i 'du shes/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i yab kyi rdo rje dang /

a las byung ba'i yum gyi padma gsal 'debs pa sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs 'di la brten nas lhan skyes mngon du bya'o snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes te/ 'du shes gsum dran par byas la 'o dang 'khyud pa la sogs pas skad cig dang po la dga' ba'i ye shes/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i rtsa btsal te rdo rje dang padma snyoms par zhugs pas skad cig gnyis pa la mchog dga'i ye shes/ rim gyis bsrubs pas byang chub sems kyis gsang gnas kyi bar gang ba khyad par gyi dga' ba'i ye shes/ nor bu'i rtse mo'i mthar thug pa'i bar gang nas phyir ma 'dzags pa chags pa dang chags bral gyi mtha' spangs pa lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes te/ de la ci nus su gnas par byas te/ rnal 'byor pa yis ji srid du/ /byang sems 'byin par mi byed par/ /de srid thob 'gyur rgyun mi chad/ /dga' ba las skyes bde gzhan ci/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter gyur pa/ /byang chub sems ni lhung gyur na/ /phung po rnam shes brgyal ba la/ /ma smad dngos grub ga la yod/ /mkha' khams rdo rje kun sbyor dang / /reg byas kyis ni rmad byung tshe'i/ /bde ba skyed par byed pa gang / /de ni mchog dga' byed pa po/ /dga' bral dag gi dbus su ni/ /mtshon pa ltos la brten par gyis/ /padma'i nam mkhar rdo rje yis/ /lte ba mnan pa'i gnas dag tu/ /rdo rje skyil krung dag gi sems/ /nor bu'i nang du son bltas pas/ /ye shes skyed pa gang yin de/ /ye shes ngo bo zhes pas brgyan/ /chags pa ma yin chags bral min/ /dbu mar dmigs pa ma yin no/ /gang tshe rnal 'byor ye shes mthong / /de la gnas bya 'gyur mi bya/ /thun nam yang na nyin gcig gam/ /zla phyed zla ba lo dang ni/ /bskal pa bskal pa stong du yang / /ye shes mngon sbyor gyis gnas bya/ /zhes brjod la ye shes ngos gzung du bcug la/ rlung nus pa can gyis mkha' gsang gnyis kyi rtse mo nas byang chub kyi sems gyen du drangs te/

lte ba dga' ba/ snying khar mchog dga'/ mgrin par khyad par gyi dga' ba/ spyi bor lhan skyes mngon du byas par bsam la/ lus thams cad la bde bas khyab pa la sems bzung ngo / /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras bkrol/ de ltar na phyag rgya'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag lam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ /zhes pa rtogs pa bskyed de shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo / /dbang bzhi ba'i yon du/ maṇḍal gling bzhi ri rab sogs nas/ dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i sogs kyis maṇḍal phul la/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /ā khaṃ sogs kyis mig ras bcings/ dbang gsum pa'i dus su nyams su myong ba'i lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes des mtshon pa'i don gyi lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes dbang bzhi pa nyid tshig gi sgo nas ngo sprad na/ rgyud las/ de ltar bzhi pa de bzhin yang / /zhes gsungs pas dbang gsum pa'i dus su yum dang zhal sbyor gyi lha'i skur bsgoms pa de nyid goms pa'i stobs kyis gnyis snang gi rtog pa thams cad 'od gsal lha'i skur gnas gyur te/ rang dang snod bcud kyi snang ba thams cad lha sku zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa can gsal la ma 'gags pa mngon du gyur pa sprul pa'i sku dang / dbang gsum pa'i gnas skabs su phyag rgya la brten pa'i bde ba de nyid rgyun goms pas/ sngar gyi bde ba las ches khyad par du 'phags pa 'dzags pa med pa'i bde ba chen po yang dag pa'i rig pa 'khor 'das thams cad bde ba chen po'i rnam par mngon du gyur pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / dbang gsum pa'i dus su bde ba'i ngo bo stong par bsgoms pa'i don goms pa las/

gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma mtha' dag dag ste/ thob bya 'bras bu dang / 'thob byed lam dang / lam de bsgom pa'i sems la sogs pa'i rtogs pa dang bral zhing khams bco brgyad dang / kun gzhi'i rnam shes la sogs pa don dam par ma grub pa thams cad stong pa 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bu rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba mngon du gyur pa ni chos kyi sku dang / de gsum dbyer med zung 'jug tu 'dres nas lha sku bde ba dang bcas pa'i snang ba mi dor zhing / de dag gi ngo bo yang stong pa nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba chos rnams kyi yin lugs la zhugs pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ 'bras bu'i dbang bzhi pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /de mngon du byas pa'i thabs ni/ lus mnyam bzhag gi spyod lam dang ldan cing / ngag rlung rgyu ba sor gzhag sems kyi lus yum dang bcas pa'i lha'i skur gsal ba dang / de'i sems rgyud 'dzag med kyi bde bas gang ba dang / de dang 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs skye 'jig 'gro 'ong / rtag chad/ 'khor 'das bde sdug la sogs pa gnyis snang thams cad dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid nam mkha' lta bu ste/ de gsum dbyer med pa'i ngang las ma yengs par mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ 'di nyid gsal zhing stong pa dang / /rig pa de nyid ma 'gags pa/ /rang rig ye shes skad cig ma/ /'di ni thog ma dbus mtha' med/ /srid med myang ngan 'das pa med/ /bdag med gzhan yang med pa ste/ /'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ /'di nyid gsal zhing stong pa nyid/ /'di las mtshon te shes par bya/ /'di yi rang bzhin sku gsum dang / /ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can/ /sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du bstan pa med/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes sku/ /gzhan du btsal bas rnyed ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras bkrol/ de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/

sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag lam shin tu spros med dang / rnam rtog 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang ba dang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed de/ dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de nas spro ba bskyed cing / dam tshig bsrung bar sgom pa ni/ mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor mthong zhing zhugs pas na/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /de ring khyod rnams legs par gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba khyod la med/ /mi tshugs pa dang mi bcings pas/ /gang la'ang 'jigs med dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu zhi ba'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las khyod 'das/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /ston pa'i mchog tu yang dag 'gyur/ /dngos grub dam tshig sdom pa 'di/ /khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bya ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsung / /mchog tu brtag pa'i bka' yin no/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /de bzhin khros nas spun rnams la/ /nyes pa brjod par mi bya'o/ /sems can rnams la byams pa'i sems/ /nam yang nges par spang mi bya/ /byang chub sems ni 'dor mi bya/ /rang gzhan chos la mi smad do/ /yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba nyid ni bstan mi bya/ /bdag gi phung po smad mi bya/ /chos rnams ngo bo sun mi dbyung / /gdug la byams pa rtag tu spang / /chos la tshad gzung mi bya'o/ /dad ldan sems can bslu mi bya/ /rtag tu dam tshig brtan par bya/ /shes rab rang bzhin bud med rnams/ /skyon gyis nyes pa mi brjod do/ /rnal 'byor slong mos mi rgyu zhing / /rnal 'byor spang bar mi bya'o/ /rtag par rgyun du gsang sngags bzlas/ /rtag tu dam tshig la sogs brtan/ /gal te bla ma smod de bzhin/ /dam tshig bag med par gyur na/ /de tshe dkyil 'khor nges bris la/

/bde gshegs rnams la sdig pa bshags/ /deng khyod skye ba 'bras bu bcas/ /gang phyir 'di la legs par gnas/ /dam tshig lha rnams dang mnyam par/ /gnas par 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can bcas pas/ /kun gyi tshad ldan de dbang bskur/ /khams gsum pa yi rgyal po che/ /rgyal srid bdag por brtan pa yin/ /de ring bdud las rnam par rgyal/ /grong khyer mchog tu rab zhugs so/ /de ring khyod kyis sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob pa 'di la the tshom med/ /'di ltar yis ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis/ /rang gi dam tshig mi zad bde ster brten par gyis/ /de ring 'gro ba bde gyur rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyod rnams phyin par 'gyur/ /zhes brjod la don bshad de dam tshig dang sdom pa'i bsrung mtshams byed par 'gyur/ de nas gnas skabs de dag tu thob pa'i dam tshig la bsrung sdom bgyi snyam pas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bsgos pa'i/ /gsung ni de ltar bdag gis bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum dang / dbang yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu/ oṃ badzra bhū mi sogs kyis maṇḍal rgyas pa phul te/ lus dang longs spyod thams cad kyang 'bul/ cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /zhes dang / sngar gtor ma rnams phul ma tshar na gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyang la/ sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa'i cho gas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma gnyis dang sgos kyis chos skyong rnams la rgyas par dbul lo/ /slob ma yod na skabs 'dir dbang bskur gyi dngos gzhi bya/ gsum pa mjug gi cho ga ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi mthar mchod pa gsar pas cung zad kha gsos la/ hrīḥṣṭīḥyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs la/

mtshan sngags re re nas sbyar ba'i chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang / nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa dang / gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin sogs kyis bstod pa rnams sngar bzhin bya/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ yig brgya'i mthar/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rdul tshon gyi phyogs la nyin zhag sbrel nas byed na/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i zhes sogs kyi mjug tu/ ji srid gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes pas brtan bzhugs dang / gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams la gshegs gsol lam/ brtan bzhugs skabs dang sbyar/ rdul tshon gshegs gsol gyi tshe bum pa gnyis dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i khyams g.yas g.yon du spyan drangs/ dpon slob rnams dkyil 'khor gyi mthar langs te/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /ces sogs lan gsum gyi mthar mtheb srin gyis se gol dang / badzra muḥzhes yang yang brjod pas/ ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod cing lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos/ chos thams cad ni dngos po med pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing mnyam pa nyid kyi don yid la dran bzhin pas/ rdo rje'i rtses dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa nas g.yas skor gyis rtsig pa rnams bshig la/ rdul tshon rnams mtha' nas rim gyis bsdu/ thig rjes rnams bum chus bkrus la/ bkra shis rgyas par bya/ rdul tshon rnams don du gnyer ba yod na cung zad sbyin tshon lhag ma rnams bsdus te/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu rlung du dor nas sa chog dang 'brel na sngar bshad pa'i sngags dang / mnyam pa'i phyag rgyas phur bu phyung la phur khung 'o mas bkang / thig rjes phyi ba sogs las rjes mi mngon par byas la/

gong bzhin bkra shis sogs rgyas par bya'o/ /ras bris kyi phyogs yin na gzhan rnams gong dang 'dra ba las/ ma 'byor ba dang zhes sogs kyis thal mo sbyar te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la sogs pa sku gzugs kyi rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing rten la me tog gtor/ rten med pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams dang / bum nang gi ye shes pa rnams/ oṃ khyed kyis zhes sogs dang / badzra muḥ ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐ḥ zhes brjod cing gnas gsum bsrungs la bsngo ba smon lam dang / bkra shis ni/ 'jam dbyangs gshin rje'i gshed dang bi rū pa/ /ḍombi pa dang wī ra ḍi pa sogs/ /rigs brgya'i mgon po rtsa brgyud bla ma yi/ /bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog /rnam shes rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes dngos/ /zhe sdang rnam dag yum dang rnam rol ba/ /thugs kyi rang bzhin gshin rje'i gshed dpal gyi/ /bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog /gzugs phung rnam dag me long ye shes dngos/ /gti mug rnam dag yum dang rnam rol ba/ /sku yi rang bzhin gshin rje'i gshed dpal gyi/ /bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog /tshor phung rnam dag mnyam nyid ye shes dngos/

/ser sna rnam dag yum dang rnam rol ba/ /yon tan rang bzhin gshin rje'i gshed dpal gyi/ /bkra shis dam pas༞ /'du shes rnam dag sor rtogs ye shes dngos/ /'dod chags rnam dag yum dang rnam rol ba/ /gsung gi rang bzhin gshin rje'i gshed dpal gyi/ /bkra shis dam pas༞ /'du byed rnam dag bya grub ye shes dngos/ /phrag dog rnam dag yum dang rnam rol ba/ /'phrin las rang bzhin gshin rje'i gshed dpal gyi/ /bkra shis༞ /gzugs sogs rnam dag zag med bde ba'i dngos/ /tshul bzhin bsten na 'chi med mchog ster ba'i/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan bum thod rnam bzhi yi/ /bkra shis༞ /bden bzhi rab rtogs bdud bzhi skrag par byed/ /tshangs gnas bzhi rdzogs sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad mtshungs/ /bsdu bzhi sogs dag gzhal med khang chen gyi/ /bkra shis༞ /rang bzhin 'od gsal sems kyi rdo rje'i dngos/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur ye shes mes/ /mi mthun phyogs 'joms bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yi/ /bkra shis༞ /dpal ldan gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam 'phrul las/ /'jig rten skyong ba bco lnga'i tshul 'dzin pa'i/ /bka' sdod chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog /ces sogs bla ma yi dam chos srung nor lha'i bkra shis sogs shis brjod kyi tshig ci rigs dang rol mo'i sgra dang me tog gi char dbab bo/ /de ltar byas pas gnas skabs su las bzhi sogs 'grub pa dang / mthar thug gshin rje'i gshed kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gshed dmar lha lnga'i mngon rtogs ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi'i bum pa dang / dkyil chog shar chen kun dga' bkra shis gyis mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho gnyis zung du sbyar ba'i khyer bde 'di yang / sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos blo dman 'jug pa bde zhing lugs 'di'i dkyil chog dar zhing rgyas par bya ba'i phyir lhag bsam kunda ltar dkar bas sbyar ba'i dge bas 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho myur du skems par gyur cig/
